public_sources.title: Sony Camera Authenticity Solution
verified_facts: Supports ILME-FX3 (Ver. 7.00 or later) and ILME-FX3A (Ver. 2.00 or later) with paid C2PA digital signature license.
ILME-FX6 (Ver. 5.00..6.02) is NOT on the Sony Camera Authenticity Solution supported camera list.
Digital signature embeds camera-captured 3D depth metadata (single-axis depth) as a C2PA digital birth certificate.

public_sources.title: Sony Digital Signature Function Help Guide — Enabling & License Installation
verified_facts: License file RQ_LIC.DAT placed in root of Slot 1 card (up to 100 licenses per file on FX3/FX30/FX3A).
Setup flow: Install License -> Connect Wi-Fi/USB for accurate time -> Create Key Pair (hardware chipset/TrustZone) -> Load Certificate -> Activate.

public_sources.title: Sony Digital Signature Function Help Guide — Loading & Deleting Certificates
verified_facts: PKCS#12 certificates sigcert.p12 / sigcert.pfx load from memory card root; FX3 video C2PA signing supports MP4 <= 222 Mbps (excludes S&Q, 8K, live streaming).
[Setting Reset] / [Initialize] preserves installed licenses, whereas [Delete Signature Func.] permanently invalidates the license.

public_sources.title: C2PA Technical Specification v2.1 — Trust Model & Hardware RoT
verified_facts: Provenance signatures rely on hardware-bound private keys (TEE/TrustZone/RPMB/SE) so post-capture tampering breaks manifest validation.
Keeping TrustZone BL31/BL32, RPMB, and p12:/cert untouched via volatile tmpfs RAM overlay avoids destroying camera private keys.

public_sources.title: DavidBuchanan314/ILCE-7M4-RE — Sony BIONZ XR BootROM, SPACC AES-XTS & Partition Layout
verified_facts: BIONZ XR BootROM maps 0xFFFF0000..0xFFFFBFFF with key scrambling pad at 0xFFFFB800 and hardware SPACC crypto engine at 0xF7FC0000.
Encrypted eMMC partitions (type=5, flag&1) use SDM2 AES-XTS-256 sector tweaks exposed via /dev/cnflasha*.

public_sources.title: Microsoft Learn — exFAT File System Specification
verified_facts: exFAT is non-journaled; VolumeFlags at Main VBR byte offset 106 (0x6A, excluded from VBR checksum) encodes VolumeDirty (bit 1).
Sudden power loss leaves VolumeDirty=1, torn Allocation Bitmap/FAT chains, or unfinalized .RSV media files; cloning read-only before repair avoids chkdsk FOUND.000 truncation.

public_sources.title: QEMU System Documentation — ivshmem-flat Device
verified_facts: ivshmem-flat exposes memory-mapped INTRMASK, INTRSTATUS, IVPOSITION, and DOORBELL registers to non-PCI Cortex-M/Cortex-R RTOS guests over the ivshmem-server protocol.
Allows Cortex-A53/A55 Linux QEMU PCI ivshmem-doorbell peers to share flat SHM and doorbells with non-PCI RTOS cores.

public_sources.title: avatartwo/avatar2 — Multi-Target Heterogeneous Firmware Orchestration
verified_facts: Bridges QEMU, Unicorn, and physical JTAG/SWD targets over QMP/TCP; incurs per-transaction Python MMIO forwarding latency under high-rate timer/DMA traffic.

public_sources.title: Icicle-emu/icicle — Multi-Architecture P-Code Coverage-Guided Rehosting
verified_facts: Rust + Ghidra SLEIGH P-code emulator (ACM CCS 2022, DOI 10.1145/3597926.3598039) optimized for single-core firmware fuzzing rather than SMP Linux + RTOS UI display co-emulation.

firmware_and_c2pa_matrix.c2pa_notes: Ver. 7.00+ supports Write Digital Signature (stills + MP4 <= 222 Mbps) via paid RQ_LIC.DAT, in-camera hardware keypair, and sigcert.p12/.pfx.
firmware_and_c2pa_matrix.lab_overlay_impact: 0% risk: volatile tmpfs bind-mounts never touch p12:/cert, TrustZone BL31/BL32, RPMB, cnflasha*, or p2/p6/p18 calibration.

firmware_and_c2pa_matrix.c2pa_notes: Not listed on Sony Camera Authenticity Solution supported cameras; p12:/cert is 20 MiB.
firmware_and_c2pa_matrix.lab_overlay_impact: Donor runtime libraries extracted strictly O_RDONLY into volatile FX3 RAM overlay; FX6 Sector 0 / p18 offset never written to FX3 eMMC.

heterogeneous_vm_comparison.ipc_transport: PCI ivshmem-doorbell + FDT + ramfb + QEMU monitor bridge
heterogeneous_vm_comparison.suitability: Primary lab target: real 4.9.337 kernel + appFw.so + unmodified ARMv7-R CP with sub-ms UIPC/FDT state sync.
Strong open-source blueprint for replacing custom monitor bridges with standard doorbells if CP moves to QEMU Cortex-R52/M.

heterogeneous_vm_comparison.ipc_transport: Unified deterministic virtual bus + OpenAMP shared ring
heterogeneous_vm_comparison.suitability: Deterministic functional AMP timing, lacks native Linux 4.9 Sony proprietary peripheral models.
Best for physical-board JTAG forwarding; high round-trip overhead under continuous camera DMA/SysTick load.
Complementary offline coverage-guided fuzzing of isolated parsers (BK4/Sector0/CrSDK); not full dual-OS display co-emulation.
